facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no exchange controls on individuals' service income.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks offer USD, GBP and EUR accounts, opened with a national ID.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Pesapal onboards sole proprietors with a registered business name and URA TIN.
facts.L1_registration: No registration needed if you trade under your own surname.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from URA, instantly online with your NIN.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed: nil to UGX 4.02m, up to 30%, plus 10% above UGX 120m.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT above UGX 300m a year; exports are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Register with the Personal Data Protection Office; not registering is an offence.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel online purchases within 7 days of receipt.
facts.L7_incentives: New citizen-owned businesses: three years without income tax.
facts.D1_id_document: National ID card with your NIN, from NIRA.

watch_out.text: Collecting customer data without PDPO registration can mean a fine or prison.
Old guides say UGX 150m; the VAT threshold is UGX 300m since July 2026.
Platforms paying through PayPal Payouts can't pay Ugandan accounts.
